input.final_result:
**Answer: Ellie Mertz is Airbnb's Chief Financial Officer as of April 7, 2025.**

**How she got the role:**
- Airbnb's board made the appointment in December 2023, with the change taking effect March 1, 2024. <cite index="8-6">The board named Ellie Mertz to the CFO post with effect from the CFO Transition Date.</cite> The transition date was set for March 1, 2024. <cite index="14-1">VP of Finance Ellie Mertz was slated to become CFO on March 1.</cite>
- She replaced Dave Stephenson, who had held the CFO job since 2019. <cite index="17-9">Mertz succeeded Dave Stephenson, who had served as Airbnb's CFO since 2019.</cite> Stephenson moved into a newly created Chief Business Officer role. <cite index="8-1">The board made him Chief Business Officer effective January 1, 2024.</cite>
- Before the promotion, she was Airbnb's Vice President of Finance. <cite index="8-7,8-8">Her VP role covered strategic finance and analytics, corporate planning, and investor relations. Before joining Airbnb in 2013, she worked at Netflix in finance roles from 2006 to 2013.</cite>

**Scope of the role:** Airbnb's investor relations site says she <cite index="1-3">leads the global finance team, covering financial planning and analysis, accounting, tax, treasury, and investor relations.</cite>

**Corroboration:** DoorDash's board biography dates her CFO tenure at Airbnb to March 2024. <cite index="10-4">It lists her as Airbnb's CFO from March 2024, after a stint as VP of Finance from January 2019 to March 2024.</cite>

**Conclusion:** Ellie Mertz has been Airbnb's CFO since March 1, 2024, so she held the role on April 7, 2025. The sources I reviewed showed no later change in that role before that date.
